show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/823HhH
show.description: A young woman who was raised by a rich family and has dreams of marrying one of the two heirs of the family. But those two brothers despise her as they believe she’s ill-mannered towards their close friend. The close friend is in fact the woman who is after the money of the two brothers and wants to replace the young woman by framing her for misdeeds.
